title: Website editor draft and publishing foundation isolates website data and authorizes own-host writes
detail:
Backend foundation for the supplied website editor shell. Store private drafts, published and scheduled captured snapshots, version restore, authenticated presence and private review threads separately from Space profile documents. Every write resolves the host-bound admin pass and current membership. Shared image ingestion enforces the same quota and metadata pipeline for Frequency and own-host website uploads while excluding protected and expired website assets. This slice does not close the E0 collaborative document or E10 visitor authentication programs.

RE-TESTED 2026-10-12 (meta scan). The migration this row waited on, 20270346007400_website_editor_state, is applied in production (schema_migrations matches the repo exactly, 810 of 810). What remains is the live exercise the evidence names: an authenticated own-domain draft save, a revision conflict, a scoped media upload and an explicit publish, plus the anonymous-read privacy check.

verify.evidence: After the pending migration is applied, exercise authenticated own-domain draft save, revision conflict, scoped original-media upload and explicit publishing. Confirm anonymous public profile reads omit private website drafts and review threads. State, authorization, media, scheduler and privacy consequences have focused regression tests; actual website-host integration remains the acceptance gate.
